name: InspirePulse Quotes
author: Online Web Tutor

sections.description:
InspirePulse Quotes is a WordPress plugin lets you display beautiful motivational and inspirational quotes anywhere on your WordPress website using powerful shortcodes.

The free version includes quote categories, auto-rotation timer control, 5 elegant built-in layouts, filters, an admin quote manager, and clean Toastr notifications.

Perfect for bloggers, educators, motivational content creators and websites that want reliable quote rotation without styling distortion.

Features (Free Version)

  • ✨ One-Click Quote Import
  • ⏱ Quote Timer Controls from plugin settings
  • 📝 Built-in Quote Manager (Add/Edit/Enable/Disable)
  • 📂 Categories Manager
  • 🔍 Quote filtering by Author and Category
  • 🎨 5 Elegant Built-in Layouts
  • 🔁 Automatic rotating quotes using JavaScript timer
  • ✅ Conflict-free scoped CSS design
  • 🔔 Toastr admin alerts and notifications
  • 🔐 Secure database interactions (prepared/de-scoped queries)

Shortcodes

  • [inspqu] – Display rotating quotes
  • [inspqu design="Elegant Dark" timer="5"] – Show specific layout with auto-rotation timing (in seconds)
  • Available design values:
    • Elegant Dark
    • Gradient Glow Box
    • Paper Vintage Look
    • Soft Minimal Box
    • Classic Card Layout
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inspirepulse-quotes folder into /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from Dashboard → Plugins
  3. Open InspirePulse Quotes → Settings to configure quote rotation timing
  4. Use shortcode anywhere in pages/posts.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin include pro features?

No. This is the free version. Pro features may be added in future updates, but the free plugin remains fully functional.

Can I change the auto-refresh timer?

Yes. Use Quote Timer Controls in settings or shortcode attribute timer="n" to rotate quotes automatically.

Can I add my own quote categories?

Yes. The free version includes Categories Manager to add and organize categories from admin dashboard.

Can I use this plugin in themes without styling issues?

Yes. The plugin uses scoped admin and public CSS, and avoids loading styles that may override theme UI.

Is this plugin compatible with caching plugins?

Yes. Quote rotation works using JavaScript timer, so caching plugins will not block the rotating effect.

Can I bulk import quotes again after deleting defaults?

Yes. You can remove default quotes using plugin option reset, and re-import them anytime using One-Click Quote Import.
